scripts.db:migrate: dbmate --migrations-dir db/migrations --no-dump-schema migrate && dbmate --migrations-dir db/migrations --schema-file db/schema.sql dump
scripts.db:rollback: dbmate --migrations-dir db/migrations --no-dump-schema rollback && dbmate --migrations-dir db/migrations --schema-file db/schema.sql dump
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
